newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end lower in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end lower in slow trade.

text.p: 1520 GMT - Swiss bonds were generally weaker in slow trade with the market mainly moving sideways in a lower range. Volume seen thin, with Dec Confederate bond futures holding mid-range. * Dec Conf futures end down 17 basis points at 114.08 * Cash 4-1/2 percent April 2006 bond yields 4.037 percent.
